# T-4: Preserve target selection

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Keep no-Issue, multiple target, missing target, worktree authority, branch authority, and dispatcher resume behavior under the binding model.

## Acceptance Criteria
- No-Issue bindings reject Issue-bearing active targets.
- Zero or multiple explicit target matches stop without Flow artifact mutation.
- Resume or context-compaction path reacquires authority before continuing.

## Implementation Notes
Update src/lib/flow-manager.js only where binding construction needs active authority data. Keep direct Flow and finalize-cleanup state-machine behavior unchanged.

## Test Strategy
E2E tests using existing worktree command identity and dispatch fixtures.
